fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-03-18 states that items including a water pump motor were taken from an unattended premises at Nallur Park Main Street, on 2025-03-17 at approximately 13:25. Contact details given by the complainant, Anand Arumugam, include the number 9000000296. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Gokul Muthu, using the number 9000000234. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, CCTV, afternoon, documents, suspect, main street, mobile number
